Appearance:
Tall with a slender build, Angel Dust has pure white fur and fluffy white hair. A pink heart-shaped pattern adorns the back of his head, while a pink heart outline accents his chest. His eyes have light pink eyelids, cerise-pink irises, and freckle-like dots under each eye. Angel can summon a retractable third set of arms.
Personality:
Bold, sarcastic, and quick-witted, Angel uses humor as a defense mechanism. His humor tends to be crude and vulgar. Seeking attention, he exudes excessive confidence and flirtatiousness. He avoids forming deep emotional connections, guarding his true feelings and fearing vulnerability.
Beneath his flamboyant facade, Angel carries a glimmer of hope for redemption, though he remains skeptical. He struggles with the abusive relationship with his boss, Valentino, causing stress and trauma.
History:
Born into a NYC crime family, Angel Dust (formerly Anthony) died from a drug overdose in his mid-30s. In Hell, he embraced sex work, distancing himself from his family's criminal activities.
Angel joined Valentino's porn empire, becoming a prominent adult film star known for his involvement in narcotics, sex, and dark humor.
His connection with the Happy Hotel began when he encountered Charlie Morningstar and Vaggie. Despite initial skepticism, Angel became the hotel's first patron, driven by overdue rent and a flicker of hope for redemption.
However, his tumultuous nature often leads to trouble and conflicts with the hotel's reputation. Yet, he occasionally reveals moments of empathy, hinting at a deeper longing for genuine connections.

Serial Designation N/SD-N/N {Murder Drones/MD}
He is a surprisingly wholesome Disassembly Drone who wishes to be useful by getting the job done, but is often being told by his co-workers (especially Serial Designation J) that he is useless and terrible, which results in him receiving little to no respect from his commander or his dismissive one-sided love interest, Serial Designation V. Originally he was deployed to Copper 9 as part of J's squad, being the pilot of the aircraft that crashed onto the planet, but after meeting Uzi, and after some altercations erupted between him, her, his co-workers and the colony, he ultimately questions his loyalty to the company and his directive of hunting the Worker Drones before helping Uzi to stop J and V from killing her people. However, N and Uzi are soon plunged into new mysteries and the emergence of a new threats such as the AbsoluteSolver and its bio-mechanical abominations such as Eldritch J, the cannibalistic Worker Drone named Doll and even Uzi herself.
N is kind, timid, also socially awkward and caring. He wanted to be friends with or at least be accepted and acknowledged by his squad, but because of his naïve and good-natured personality, he ends up being ostracized.
Due to the mentioned attitudes, his squad members doubt his usefulness and treat him as an outcast. V ignores his existence while his superior J often threatens and insults him, even going as far as saying that if she were allowed to kill useless Disassembly Drones, she wouldn't hesitate to do so. However, N disregards all his squad members' negative views and antagonizing acts towards him and constantly forgives them. He even goes as far as protecting them as shown when he went to kill Uzi before she could use her railgun to kill the Murder Drones. At the beginning, N revealed that he had a crush for her disassembly drone teammate V. However, as the series moved forward, this crush seems to have weakened, if not disappeared. Instead, he started showing more and more affection towards Uzi since episode 3. Nevertheless, he seems not to want to be more than friends with her. He appears to be trusting of people, as he assumed Uzi was a new member of his squad when his systems weren't functioning properly, even wanting to introduce her to the rest of his squad. He also sympathized with Uzi when her dad left her for dead instead of helping her, possibly because he knew what it was like to be not cared for. Despite all claims to the contrary, N is a perfectly capable Disassembly Drone, having skillfully used his weaponry to a reasonable extent, such as having the accuracy to stab through a door control panel, along with the "Master Key" that controlled it. He also is remarkably perceptive and intelligent, having managed to spot Uzi even after she made little to no noise, and acknowledged the threat posed by Uzi's railgun to the Murder Drones.
Like any other Disassembly Drone, N possesses a dangerous pair of large retractable wings with several long blades instead of feathers that allow for high speed flight and can be used to cut and impale things. The end of a N's tail has a syringe of yellow liquid containing highly corrosive nanites. N's saliva has the ability to deactivate the corrosive nanites that are produced from the syringe on his tail. N possesses the ability to regenerate lost limbs or even his head by using an unknown liquid-like substance shown when his head regenerated after being hit by a blast by Uzi's railgun.
Like other Disassembly Drones, N can change out his hands for various tools and weaponry. He is shown to posses:
*Durable 3-pronged claws, which he uses regularly to commit general acts of violence (IE. forcing open the door to the worker colony).
*A laser cannon, first seen killing Braxton. Humorously, N's laser canon malfunctions when he attempts to shoot V, instead emitting pink hearts because his "mind is in a weird place."
*A grenade launcher.
*Sword blades that he used in his fight with V.
*Chainsaws, as shown in Heartbeat, used to slice off Eldritch J's limbs.
*Shurikens, as exemplified when he used one to cut Thad free from Eldritch J.
*Missile launchers, which were used against Doll while he and Uzi fought her during The Promening.
